scope: declared container isolation verified against the real runtime config before start
why: 容器参数只是请求；Docker 会自行改写其中一部分（已实测 tmpfs 默认追加 noexec）。因此隔离必须在 docker create 之后、docker start 之前按 docker inspect 的真实 HostConfig 复核，失败则不启动。
boundaries: proves the declared flags took effect for this container
does not prove kernel-level isolation against a malicious tenant (containers share the kernel)
does not replace business SLO measurement under concurrent load

observed_in_container.work_quota: yes (200MiB write to a 128MiB tmpfs failed)

defect_found_and_fixed.symptom: Docker appends noexec to every --tmpfs mount, including when explicit options are given
defect_found_and_fixed.impact: compiled binaries and test runners inside /work failed with Permission denied; cargo test style workloads could not run at all
defect_found_and_fixed.measurement: before: tmpfs /work ... rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec ; /work/p -> Permission denied (exit 126); after adding exec: work_exec=yes
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: --tmpfs=/work now carries exec, and isolation::verify rejects any /work tmpfs that lacks exec

automated_rules.src/isolation.rs::declared_container_iso: create args carry every required flag
automated_rules.src/isolation.rs::host_access_and_writab: writable rootfs, bind mounts, volumes-from, privileged, extra caps, host pid/user namespace, device passthrough, group 0, arbitrary mounts and root user are each rejected
automated_rules.src/isolation.rs::network_and_lifetime_a: network mode, port publishing, restart policy, log driver, missing no-new-privileges and missing init are rejected
automated_rules.src/isolation.rs::resource_limits_must_m: memory, memory-swap, nano CPUs, pids, ulimits and tmpfs size/mode must match the request
automated_rules.src/isolation.rs::non_executable_workspa: a /work tmpfs without exec is rejected
automated_rules.src/isolation.rs::unreadable_or_foreign_: unparsable inspect output and a foreign job label are rejected

live_tests.tests/isolation_live.rs::declared_isolat: creates a container with the runner's real args, verifies inspect, starts it and re-checks uid/caps/no-new-privs/cgroup limits/read-only rootfs/socket/exec semantics/quota
live_tests.tests/isolation_live.rs::tampered_contai: a container created without --read-only and --cap-drop is refused before start

residual_risks: 容器共享内核；本证据不覆盖恶意租户或内核漏洞
业务 SLO（并行构建对业务延迟、swap、磁盘水位的影响）仍需在业务主机上实测
本次只在 linux/arm64 的 lima worker 上执行；okm182 (linux/amd64) 在测量时 SSH 不可用，未计为已验证
